records.title: Locking Pretrained Weights via Deep Low-Rank Residual Distillation
records.reason: DLR-Lock replaces MLPs with deep low-rank residual networks to make fine-tuning attacks more expensive; the paper explicitly exploits training-versus-inference asymmetry and targets backward-pass cost. It is a model-security/anti-fine-tuning method, not inference optimization.

records.title: An Information-Theoretic Criterion for Efficient Data Synthesis
records.reason: This paper selects data for synthetic-data generation using information-theoretic criteria. Its target is data synthesis efficiency and training-data quality, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: ZeroSwap: Minimizing Swap Overhead for Real-Time Multi-DNN Inference via SSD-based GPU Memory Extension
records.reason: linked/LLM-inference候補の可能性があるが、一次publisher資料を取得できず、対象範囲との関係を本文で確定できない。packet abstractや二次情報だけでunrelated/followupを断定せず、一次資料へのアクセス時に再判定する。

records.title: From Detection to Recovery: Operational Analysis on LLM Pre-training with 504 GPUs
records.reason: The arXiv report analyzes failure monitoring, checkpoint I/O, and recovery during LLM pre-training on a GPU cluster. All performance measurements are for training operations and recovery, not inference.

records.title: System-Prompt Anchoring with Cross-Attention Layers
records.reason: System-Prompt Anchoring adds cross-attention blocks to inject privileged system-prompt content. The paper measures added parameters, memory, prefill, TTFT, and decode overhead (for the 1.5B setting these increase); its contribution concerns instruction/security behavior and prompt injection, not reducing inference cost.
